messages:
elaine-support: VeraCorp just escalated — their invoice for 2026-04-12 is ~12k tokens lower than the dashboard. They say the usage CSV doesn't contain rows for 2026-04-12 00:00-01:00 UTC. Can exports/ops confirm? This is blocking a billing dispute. :alarm_clock:

raj-ops: on it. can you paste the exact manifest + an example of the CSV they got? also which customer_id?

elaine-support: customer_id=vera-corp
S3 manifest they provided: s3://redwood-prod/exports/2026-04-12/manifest-2026-04-12T01.json
CSV excerpt they received (note empty for midnight hour):
```
customer_id,hour_bucket,token_count
vera-corp,2026-04-12T01:00:00Z,32456
vera-corp,2026-04-12T02:00:00Z,29812
```
No 2026-04-12T00:00:00Z row. Dashboard query shows tokens for that hour though: `SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE customer_id='vera-corp' AND hour_bucket='2026-04-12T00:00:00Z' -- returns 12034`

export-bot: Export job completed: job_id=exp-2026-04-12-00 shard=7 status=COMPLETED files=[s3://redwood-prod/exports/2026-04-12/shard-7-00.csv(size=0), s3://redwood-prod/exports/2026-04-12/shard-7-01.csv(size=12KB)] :eyes: 

ingrid-sre: quick glance at export service logs shows worker-7 restarted at 2026-04-12T00:04:12Z. There is a gap in the aggregator heartbeat between 2026-04-12T00:03:45Z and 2026-04-12T00:06:00Z. That aligns with the missing hour rows. Suspect the export worker committed a zero-byte file for that shard before backfilling finished. I'll tail logs and check upstream ingestion queue for replays.

raj-ops: repro plan for backfill if ingestion data present:
1) run internal query to extract raw events for customer for window 2026-04-12T00:00:00Z - 2026-04-12T00:59:59Z:
```
SELECT * FROM raw_usage_events
WHERE customer_id='vera-corp' AND event_time >= '2026-04-12T00:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2026-04-12T01:00:00Z';
```
2) if events exist, regenerate hour-aggregation and produce a corrected CSV for that hour and upload to s3 path from manifest, update manifest and re-run manifest verification.
3) notify billing & customer with patched CSV attached.
ETA ~6h if raw events present. If raw events were purged or never ingested, need to coordinate with customer to provide request ids for replay.

maria-billing: flagging for billing review. Customer wants credit if we can't resolve within 48h. Please provide ETA and attach final CSV when done so I can calculate credit.

ingrid-sre: found the root cause in logs: an autoscaler drain happened hitting worker-7 during the end of the hour; the aggregator flush job raced with a graceful shutdown hook. We already have a fix branch to delay commit until post-flush. I'll open a hotfix PR and trigger a manual backfill now.

raj-ops: starting manual backfill now. grabbing raw events and running aggregation locally, will push corrected file to `s3://redwood-prod/exports/2026-04-12/shard-7-00.csv` and update manifest. I'll post upload link when complete. :thumbsup:

elaine-support: thanks. I'll tell VeraCorp we're working on a manual fix and will hold invoice adjustments pending results. Please mark progress here so I can update the customer.

export-bot: manual upload complete: s3://redwood-prod/exports/2026-04-12/shard-7-00.csv(size=11KB) manifest updated at 2026-04-12T06:41:12Z

raj-ops: verified regenerated CSV matches dashboard tokens for that hour (`token_count=12034`). Re-run manifest validation and kicked off ingestion for downstream billing.

maria-billing: confirmed. I'll recompute invoice and issue a temporary hold on the disputed amount. Maria -> follow-up: will CC the customer with corrected CSV and new invoice in ~2h after downstream systems consume the backfill.

elaine-support: great, customer told. closing loop after final invoice. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
